svg.title: 1. Network stack: transport and execution are separate choices
svg.desc: Staff browsers or future field devices communicate over premises or remote links. Current computation runs in a browser worker or Vercel function. An internal AI server and shared institutional records are proposed.

g.text: Transport carries the data. Execution determines which computer analyses it.

g.title: staff to premises
field to remote
premises to routing: web access
remote to routing: ingestion adapter needed
routing to device: device route
routing to vercel: hosted route
routing to internal: intranet route needed
device to browserstore: reviewed result
vercel to browserstore: returned to browser
internal to sharedstore: shared persistence
Staff browser [current] Phone / laptop
Field camera or sensor [future] Release container / adult trap
Same-premises link [reference] Ethernet / Wi-Fi Nearby BLE sensor uses a gateway
Remote uplink [reference] Photos: cellular / private radio bridge Small readings: LoRaWAN + gateway
Application and route choice [current] Select a permitted execution target
Device worker [current] Small bead CV / numeric ML
Vercel function [current] Small bead CV
Internal AI service [future] Shared on-premises compute
Browser records [current] IndexedDB / localStorage
Institutional records [future] Local database / image archive

g.text: Solid routes: current software or labelled reference patterns. Dashed routes: future integration.
Physical network equipment and remote ingestion are not deployed by this prototype.
